title: Illustrator neco's Heavily Armed High School Girls Project Gets TV Anime
content: Good Smile Company announced on Friday that illustrator neco 's Heavily Armed High School Girls ( Jū Heisōgata Joshi Kōsei ) project is getting a television anime adaptation that will air in 2027.

title: 'Magic Knight Rayearth (2026)' Announces Additional Cast
content: The official website for the new Magic Knight Rayearth ( Mahou Kishi Rayearth ) television anime announced additional cast members on Friday. The anime adapting CLAMP 's mahou shoujo manga is scheduled to premiere on TV Asahi's "IMAnimation W" frame at 11.45 p.m. in October 2026.
author: MyAnimeList

title: BLACK TORCH Anime Reveals New Trailer, Key Visual, Theme Songs by SiM and I Don't Like Mondays
content: The upcoming BLACK TORCH anime revealed a new key visual and main trailer, while also announcing its opening and ending theme songs ahead of its July 4, 2026 premiere. The series first announced the anime adaptation back in March, surprising with its return following the manga’s cancellation in 2018.
author: Anime Corner

title: Illustrator Neco's Heavily Armed High School Girls Gets TV Anime in 2027
content: Illustrator neco’s original multimedia project Heavy Armored High School Girls is officially getting a TV anime adaptation, with the premiere set for 2027. The adaptation marks the franchise’s first animated project.
author: Anime Corner

title: Victoria of Many Faces TV Anime Reveals July 7 Debut in Short Promo Video
content: The staff for the television anime of writer Syuu and illustrator Nanna Fujimi 's Victoria of Many Faces ( Tefuda ga Ōme no Victoria ) light novel series revealed a short promotional video and the anime's July 7 debut on Friday.
